Proposed requirement: The system shall register one initial managing organization while keeping organization identity configurable and modeling third-party entities as related counterparties, not separate tenants.
Acceptance condition: A configured organization administers many projects; partner entities cannot inherit organization-wide privileges.

Proposed requirement: The system shall maintain configurable hierarchical organizational units, positions, coverage areas and external CBO records independently of fixed names or counts.
Acceptance condition: A unit reassignment and a CBO with no account do not require database enum changes or a new organization.

Proposed requirement: The system shall distinguish a person, login account, staff position, farmer business identity and effective-dated assignments.
Acceptance condition: One person transfers roles without duplicate identity or rewritten historical actors.

Proposed requirement: Organizational hierarchy and administrative geography shall be separate; rights shall reflect current effective assignments rather than residence alone.
Acceptance condition: A moved staff member loses old-region reads while history remains intact.

Proposed requirement: Authorized administrators shall manage organization, project and geography scopes through guarded, audited services, not unrestricted table writes.
Acceptance condition: Direct restricted SQL is denied; valid request maintains hierarchy and assignment consistency.

Proposed requirement: Each business operation shall require an explicit action permission evaluated against actor, resource, organization, project, geography and relevant relationship.
Acceptance condition: Matrix verifies AND intersections and denies out-of-scope combinations.

Proposed requirement: Scope sets shall apply all clauses conjunctively; alternative grants may be considered disjunctively only as independently valid sets.
Acceptance condition: A Zone-A-and-Project-1 grant never becomes Zone-A-or-Project-1.

Proposed requirement: Role/grant administration shall be database-configurable using `role.create`, `role.update`, `permission.grant`, `user.role.assign` or reviewed equivalent action IDs.
Acceptance condition: Client adds a role without source edits; no grant exceeds delegator authority.

Proposed requirement: High-risk grants shall require two distinct authorized approvers, no requester self-approval, and protected risk classification.
Acceptance condition: One approver cannot activate restricted exports; reclassifying risk needs independent control.

Proposed requirement: Temporary grants shall have validity windows, justification, automatic expiry and audited approvals; emergency elevation shall use stronger authentication, short duration and independent review.
Acceptance condition: Expired grant is denied at PostgreSQL even with stale frontend cache.

Proposed requirement: Transfer, suspension, departure and reassignment shall recalculate authorization, revoke impacted server sessions and preserve prior provenance.
Acceptance condition: Historical actor retains identity while old-region access is denied.

Proposed requirement: System shall schedule configurable risk-based access reviews: proposed quarterly for privileged, six-monthly for ordinary, plus event-driven review.
Acceptance condition: Reviewer records retain/modify/revoke outcome and overdue reminders.

Proposed requirement: Privileged accounts shall use MFA, others risk-based MFA; high-risk operations shall require fresh step-up verification.
Acceptance condition: Unauthorized bypass and stale step-up are rejected; recovery is audited.

Proposed requirement: Device administration shall be separately granted through `device.view`, `device.approve`, `device.revoke` with no self-approval.
Acceptance condition: Operator lacking device.approve cannot enroll their own browser profile.

Proposed requirement: Enrollment withdrawal shall require separate `enrollment.withdraw`, provisionally administrator-delegated at pilot, with future roles allowed by reviewed policy.
Acceptance condition: Field-source direct withdrawal is denied until separately approved; authorized withdrawal retains history.

Proposed requirement: Create a farmer business identity with stable server/client UUID, name in at least one supported language, configured village/GN, creator/source/time and notice-delivery evidence.
Acceptance condition: Missing optional phone/NIC does not block valid minimum registration.

Proposed requirement: Identity numbers, contacts, bank details and other sensitive attributes shall be optional separate protected categories rather than mandatory base-profile fields.
Acceptance condition: Basic-read user cannot retrieve the fields by detail, search, export or error payload.

Proposed requirement: Project-specific farmer forms shall use versioned templates, conditional required fields only after client-approved purpose and validation policy.
Acceptance condition: Historical submission remains interpretable after a template update.

Proposed requirement: System shall support candidate duplicate detection, review and linking without silent merging of distinct farmers.
Acceptance condition: Duplicate candidate is flagged; original source identifiers and audit are preserved.

Proposed requirement: Farmers shall support pending-review, verified, inactive and other approved status transitions with reasons, effective dates and audit.
Acceptance condition: Transition requires allowed scope and version; prior status remains reportable.

Proposed requirement: Farmer geography corrections shall change visibility and assignment-based access atomically without rewriting history or auto-withdrawing project enrollment.
Acceptance condition: Officer outside new scope cannot read or correct on next request.

Proposed requirement: Registration shall record delivery of the current approved bilingual privacy notice, including authorized verbal-delivery indication when applicable.
Acceptance condition: Notice ID/version/language/delivery method/date preserved with actor.

Proposed requirement: Additional purpose-specific consent shall be tracked separately where approved legal basis/policy requires it.
Acceptance condition: Withdrawal of optional consent stops affected optional processing subject to lawful holds and policy.

Proposed requirement: Sensitive identity reads shall be masked by default and require explicit purpose/scope-bound grants with audited reveal.
Acceptance condition: User with farmer.read alone sees only masked/omitted values.

Proposed requirement: The system shall preserve original registration sources and migration lineage for imported farmers, including import batch and row reference.
Acceptance condition: A duplicate import is idempotent and source record remains traceable.

Proposed requirement: Farmer residence/registration geography shall not be assumed to equal parcel geography, cultivator rights or project allocation.
Acceptance condition: Separate records can hold different valid areas and distinct effective dates.

Proposed requirement: Retired/inactive farmer records shall obey approved retention, legal holds and pseudonymization/erasure policies without destroying transaction integrity.
Acceptance condition: Attempted delete while on hold is refused and logged.

Proposed requirement: Each land parcel shall have identity, separately configured administrative geography, creator/time, description and version, independent of current farmer address.
Acceptance condition: Parcel may be registered with no title documents while minimum identity/geography rules pass.

Proposed requirement: Parcel-person relationships shall include configurable owner, tenant, cultivator, manager and other client-approved types with effective dates, source and review status.
Acceptance condition: Multiple people share a parcel without overwriting relationships; relationship is not title proof.

Proposed requirement: Required land evidence shall be configurable by project/relationship; basic land intake shall remain possible without supporting documents.
Acceptance condition: Lack of attachment creates pending evidence state, not automatic rejection of base record.

Proposed requirement: First-release GIS shall render scope-filtered interactive basemaps, farmer/parcel pins, polygon layers and configurable project/region overlays.
Acceptance condition: Two-officer map tests reveal no unauthorized marker, count, tile overlay or boundary.

Proposed requirement: Authorized users shall draw, edit and import parcel boundary polygons with validation, history and per-action authorization.
Acceptance condition: Invalid polygon is flagged; original approved version preserved on attempted edit.

Proposed requirement: Boundary versions shall track GPS, digitized and official-survey sources, accuracy, recorded/surveyed dates, actor, evidence and verification state.
Acceptance condition: Provisional phone polygon is clearly distinguishable from approved survey.

Proposed requirement: Boundary states shall support provisional, review, verified, disputed and superseded outcomes, with separate permission for verification.
Acceptance condition: Editing boundary does not silently set legal-verified status.

Proposed requirement: Store reported, legally surveyed and GIS-calculated areas separately, with original unit, source, version and validation status.
Acceptance condition: 2.0-acre recorded and 2.3-acre GIS area remain independently retrievable.

Proposed requirement: Configurable project policy shall select which validated area is authoritative for eligibility and quota calculations, with historical effective versions.
Acceptance condition: Quota uses configured validated measure, not latest unapproved GPS polygon.

Proposed requirement: Field officers shall be able to initiate a walk-the-boundary session that samples GPS as they walk and derives a proposed polygon and area.
Acceptance condition: Complete visible-foreground walk can produce a reviewable polygon without manual point-by-point drawing.

Proposed requirement: Tracking shall support explicit start/stop/pause/resume, display accuracy, and warn about stale fixes, anomalous jumps and incomplete closure.
Acceptance condition: Interruption does not silently bridge a gap or accept a low-confidence segment.

Proposed requirement: Officer shall be able to review and manually correct GPS points/segments without destroying the underlying survey provenance.
Acceptance condition: Correction records prior version and reason before provisional save.

Proposed requirement: Authorized offline boundary capture/edit shall write encrypted local survey drafts and queued geometry mutations, with stable IDs and schema versions.
Acceptance condition: Offline restart preserves edits; reconnect uses original IDs and succeeds or surfaces conflict.

Proposed requirement: The server shall validate polygon geometry, area, tenant/org boundary, current permissions, expected version and allowed transitions before accepting GIS mutation.
Acceptance condition: Cross-region or self-intersecting geometry cannot bypass guarded write endpoint.

Proposed requirement: Overlap detection shall calculate candidate overlap area and affected parcel identities only within the reviewer's authorized scope.
Acceptance condition: Intentional overlap flagged; no unauthorized neighboring parcel details leaked.

Proposed requirement: Overlapping parcels may be saved provisionally but conflicted portions shall not become verified/allocatable without permitted resolution.
Acceptance condition: Dispute remains visible until authorized review; quota cannot double-count unapproved area.

Proposed requirement: Raw GPS tracks shall be purpose-limited survey evidence, stored only per configured retention and explicit survey activation, separate from final geometry.
Acceptance condition: No location collection outside active survey; retention expiration removes eligible tracks without deleting polygon.

Proposed requirement: Map provider configuration shall be replaceable; offline basemap downloads require a documented rights-approved source and area limit.
Acceptance condition: Disallowed provider cannot be bulk-cached; attribution/license recorded.

Proposed requirement: GIS shall support spatial filtering, area summaries, overlap and coverage analysis with scope-aware statistics and export permissions.
Acceptance condition: Region A viewer cannot deduce Region B totals via cross-filter aggregation.

Proposed requirement: GIS area and GPS confidence shall be represented as estimates unless verified survey status supports stronger designation.
Acceptance condition: User sees uncertainty/source; system never labels mobile GPS output cadastral proof.

Proposed requirement: Farmers may have more than one current enrollment across projects where separately eligible.
Acceptance condition: Enroll Project A then B; two current enrollments valid under distinct project policies.

Proposed requirement: Duplicate current enrollment within the same project/cycle policy shall be rejected, while new row after withdrawal or eligible renewal is allowed.
Acceptance condition: Concurrent duplicate attempts yield one authoritative active record and auditable outcome.

Proposed requirement: Projects shall be configurable as continuous or seasonal, with separately versioned cycles, start/end dates and statuses.
Acceptance condition: Same project definition supports both policy models without schema fork.

Proposed requirement: Renewal policy shall be per project; proposed pilot seasonal cycles require a new enrollment and continuous membership persists.
Acceptance condition: Rollover never silently creates an approved enrollment.

Proposed requirement: Project/cycle closure shall be manual by authorized users in pilot, with configurable closure policy and end-date warnings.
Acceptance condition: Date passage alone does not change status before approved action.

Proposed requirement: Per-project approval mode shall be versioned; pilot activation after validation, with configurable review/approval workflow for later projects.
Acceptance condition: Immediate path and approval-required path each reject unauthorized actor.

Proposed requirement: Enrollment shall record observed field-event time, server receipt/confirmation time and configurable official effective time, pilot default server confirmation.
Acceptance condition: Device clock shift does not rewrite authoritative server timestamp.

Proposed requirement: Per-project prerequisites shall configure eligible farmer statuses; proposed pilot allows pending-review/verified and denies inactive.
Acceptance condition: Decision reevaluated on each offline sync, not only when queued.

Proposed requirement: If enrolled farmer becomes ineligible/inactive, flag current enrollment for review without auto-withdrawal; benefit restrictions follow project policy.
Acceptance condition: Prior history retained and issue eligibility enforced separately.

Proposed requirement: Farmer geography changes shall trigger scope recalculation and coverage exceptions without automatic membership deletion.
Acceptance condition: Former officer loses view, authorized project manager sees review flag.

Proposed requirement: Each project shall define whether eligibility geography follows farmer registration or a linked parcel/plot location.
Acceptance condition: Changing policy version affects new evaluations with tracked provenance.

Proposed requirement: `enrollment.create` shall require current session, permission, project assignment, geography intersection, farmer.read and enabled project eligibility policy.
Acceptance condition: A project-only or region-only grant is insufficient where both required.

Proposed requirement: Authorized officers may queue enrollment intents offline and synchronize them automatically after valid reconnection or via Sync Now.
Acceptance condition: Queue shows pending/not-guaranteed; server may reject when policy changed.

Proposed requirement: An officer may create an offline enrollment dependent on a newly queued farmer registration in the same vault.
Acceptance condition: Sync creates/authorizes farmer first, then evaluates dependent enrollment exactly once with stable IDs.

Proposed requirement: A rejected/conflicted farmer registration shall prevent dependent enrollment submission and show blocked-dependency recovery without deleting the child intent.
Acceptance condition: Parent rejection leaves child local and actionable; no phantom enrollment row.

Proposed requirement: Refusal responses shall show authorized officers safe actionable reason categories without revealing confidential policy or other actors' records.
Acceptance condition: Revoked officer receives only generic denial; authorized admin can review scoped detailed reason events.

Proposed requirement: Queue shall cap unresolved enrollment intents at 100/account/device with warning at 80; never delete unsent items to free capacity.
Acceptance condition: 101st blocked with recovery UI; first 100 intact.

Proposed requirement: Unresolved enrollment queue entries shall warn at seven days and escalate at 30 days, without age-based deletion.
Acceptance condition: Simulated overdue local vault shows warning; no claim of server-visible alert while disconnected.

Proposed requirement: Enrollment withdrawal shall be an explicit audited state transition with reasons and separate privileges, leaving immutable historical row.
Acceptance condition: Authorized withdrawal followed by eligible re-enrollment creates a fresh row.

Proposed requirement: Project benefit allocation shall recheck current farmer/project/cycle status and any hold, not equate enrollment existence to unconditional entitlement.
Acceptance condition: Ineligible status blocks configured distribution even when enrollment record remains active.

Proposed requirement: Resource catalog shall support configurable types, units, categories and organization/program applicability without hardcoding crop types.
Acceptance condition: Admin registers seeds, seedlings and fertilizer units under approved policy.

Proposed requirement: Every stock-affecting receipt, issue, transfer, return, loss, damage, correction or adjustment shall create an immutable auditable ledger event.
Acceptance condition: Stock balance can be reconstructed from posted events and corrections never erase original.

Proposed requirement: Officers may distribute only authorized, already allocated stock while offline, and each issuance stays provisional until server confirms.
Acceptance condition: Offline negative/duplicate/cross-scope issue is not silently committed.

Proposed requirement: Officer confirmation shall be mandatory at pilot; farmer acknowledgment method shall be configurable per resource/project and optional by default.
Acceptance condition: No biometric required; absence of optional acknowledgment is recorded without inventing signature.

Proposed requirement: Loss and correction transactions shall require approved pilot authorization; returns shall require physical receipt verification and separate events.
Acceptance condition: Unauthorized adjustment denied, original stock journal retained.

Proposed requirement: Each resource shall define authoritative base unit and allowed conversion factors with version/effective date.
Acceptance condition: Ten plants stored integer; mass uses decimal and invalid conversion fails.

Proposed requirement: Every quantity-affecting event shall preserve entered quantity/unit and validated normalized base quantity in exact numeric types.
Acceptance condition: Same movement reproduces identical normalized quantity after conversion version changes.

Proposed requirement: Inter-location transfers shall require sender dispatch and receiver receipt confirmation, including partial receipts and discrepancies.
Acceptance condition: Stock in transit not eligible for new offline officer allocation before receipt confirmation.

Proposed requirement: Resource-specific lot tracking shall capture source, batch ID, relevant dates/expiry and traceability to individual farmer issues when enabled.
Acceptance condition: Query reconstructs batch-to-farmer distribution without unrestricted report leakage.

Proposed requirement: Quotas shall be configurable by project, resource, cycle, farmer category and approved area, with effective policy version.
Acceptance condition: Over-limit issuance rejected at server; provisional offline status disclosed.

Proposed requirement: Validated authoritative parcel area shall be used for area-based quotas; disputed/unverified area shall not inflate eligible quantity.
Acceptance condition: A disputed 0.2 acre overlap does not add quota without approved decision.

Proposed requirement: Offline distribution sync shall use stable mutation IDs, stock allocation version and expected balance/ceiling checks, preserving conflicts for reconciliation.
Acceptance condition: Two disconnected officers cannot both confirm the same finite allocation at server.

Proposed requirement: Corrections and reversals shall be compensating transactions linked to original events with reason, approver and audit.
Acceptance condition: Reversal changes balance without UPDATE/DELETE on ledger rows.

Proposed requirement: Transfers and allocation receipts shall expose statuses proposed, dispatched, partially received, received, disputed and reconciled as supported by approved transitions.
Acceptance condition: Full and partial receipt histories remain inspectable.

Proposed requirement: Inventory queries, transfers and distribution exports shall honor current RBAC+ABAC, restricting balances by location/project and farmer/lot details by purpose.
Acceptance condition: Authorized officer sees own preallocation, not all warehouse holdings.

Proposed requirement: First release shall include comprehensive role-specific dashboards, charts, KPI summaries, configurable filters and time-series or distribution reports.
Acceptance condition: Test approved stock, enrollment, area and farmer measures against authoritative transaction fixtures.

Proposed requirement: The system shall support customizable report definitions and scheduled execution without exposing arbitrary SQL or bypassing database security.
Acceptance condition: User-defined report cannot read hidden table/tenant through filter or aggregation.

Proposed requirement: Reports shall support authorized export to Excel, CSV and PDF, with complete Sinhala/English labels where required.
Acceptance condition: Export count, grouping, numeric units and date filters match authorized on-screen results.

Proposed requirement: Distinct permissions shall govern dashboard.view, report.view, report.export, report.schedule and sensitive report categories.
Acceptance condition: View grant alone cannot export, schedule or download a restricted report.

Proposed requirement: Delivery channels shall include dashboard retrieval, notifications and authenticated expiring links; sensitive attachments only per policy.
Acceptance condition: Old/forwarded link fails after revoked permission, expiry or account mismatch.

Proposed requirement: Downloads shall reauthorize actor and scope on use and generate export/download audit entries.
Acceptance condition: User with permission revoked after scheduling cannot retrieve newly generated sensitive export.

Proposed requirement: KPI definitions shall specify source tables, effective date, inclusion/exclusion states, aggregation and unit before client acceptance.
Acceptance condition: Example count excludes retired/unconfirmed events per versioned definition.

Proposed requirement: GIS reports shall separate estimated, surveyed, validated and disputed land areas rather than silently summing overlapping polygons.
Acceptance condition: Report shows distinct categories and flags scope-specific overlap uncertainty.

Proposed requirement: Scheduled report execution shall use authenticated service jobs with recipient authorization rechecks and retained delivery outcomes.
Acceptance condition: Recipient losing grant receives no sensitive attachment on next schedule.

Proposed requirement: Plan targets shall retain approved/draft source versions and unresolved arithmetic issues; do not turn a printed incorrect total into confirmed actual.
Acceptance condition: Source plan 2,700 vs sum 2,760 remains blocked from final KPI baseline until approved correction.

Proposed requirement: Map-based analytics and spatial reporting shall use scope-filtered queries and approved basemap/imagery providers.
Acceptance condition: No hidden geography count or polygon via report tiles or drilldowns.

Proposed requirement: Report customizations shall be limited to allowed measures/dimensions for the user's context, with bounded query cost.
Acceptance condition: Unauthorized measure unavailable and query hits configured safeguards.

Proposed requirement: Device offline vault shall store only separately authorized minimum data and exclude NIC, financial details and sensitive documents by default.
Acceptance condition: Storage inspection shows encrypted minimal records only, no disallowed categories or browser tokens.

Proposed requirement: Both BYOD and organization devices may be individually approved subject to minimum security checks; offline is restricted when posture cannot be verified.
Acceptance condition: Unknown/unsupported browser cannot create offline draft; safe recovery of existing ciphertext remains possible.

Proposed requirement: Offline authoring shall have configurable policy-bound maximum, proposed pilot seven days since successful online authentication.
Acceptance condition: Expired offline authoring locks new edits and never auto-deletes unresolved data.

Proposed requirement: Offline vault shall use local unlock and inactivity locking independently of server login; sync requires fresh live server authorization.
Acceptance condition: Local unlock after revocation cannot obtain new server access.

Proposed requirement: Lost device shall trigger server session/device revocation, audited replacement approval and encrypted recovery only from accessible approved sources.
Acceptance condition: New device requires reapproval; disconnected lost phone is not claimed remotely erased.

Proposed requirement: Optional vault recovery-key mechanism shall be preconfigured, encryption-preserving, controlled by approval and separately security-reviewed before enabled.
Acceptance condition: Missing recovery material cannot be bypassed by admin password reset.

Proposed requirement: Farmer, dependent enrollment, authorized distribution and GIS mutations shall use one durable per-account/device encrypted outbox, not competing sync engines.
Acceptance condition: Each mutation has stable IDs and survives normal browser restart.

Proposed requirement: Offline dependency graph shall topologically order farmer creation before dependent enrollment and preserve dependency on retries/conflicts.
Acceptance condition: Parent success maps canonical farmer ID; child never sent against nonexistent farmer.

Proposed requirement: Offline GIS edits shall use expected geometry version and conflict queues rather than last-write-wins for authoritative boundaries.
Acceptance condition: Two officers' concurrent edits retain both proposed versions for review.

Proposed requirement: Offline distribution may not create authoritative inventory balance until server validates allocation, quota, physical receipt and current scope.
Acceptance condition: Local UI marks record pending and stock ledger remains server authoritative.

Proposed requirement: Sync shall support automatic reconnect retry with bounded backoff, manual Sync Now and durable states for pending, synced, rejected, conflict and unconfirmed.
Acceptance condition: Lost response replays same ID and creates no duplicate authoritative row.

Proposed requirement: Offline synchronization shall distinguish authentication failure, authorization denial, business conflict, invalid payload and uncertain post-send outcome.
Acceptance condition: Commit-then-revoke yields unconfirmed rather than false rejected or success.

Proposed requirement: Queue saturation/age notices shall be local-first, with server-visible escalation only after an approved reconnect-time message.
Acceptance condition: Fully disconnected device creates no fictitious server alert.

Proposed requirement: Account/device partitions, non-exportable possession keys where supported, key binding and revocation status shall be enforced before sync.
Acceptance condition: Vault/account swap and wrong device session fail closed.

Proposed requirement: Client schema migrations and releases shall preserve pending vault records, support staged upgrades and tested rollback recovery.
Acceptance condition: Old vault to new reader retains encrypted data and stable mutation IDs.

Proposed requirement: Offline archive/recovery shall preserve all unresolved drafts and their dependencies, verify archive integrity and authorization, and block unsafe cross-account/device import.
Acceptance condition: Tampered archive fails and original preserved; no unauthorized device restore.

Proposed requirement: Approved privacy notices shall be language-versioned and reviewable; UI shall record notice delivery without assuming consent equals every legal basis.
Acceptance condition: Data has purpose-notice version and legal review record.

Proposed requirement: Retention shall be configurable by data category with archive, anonymize, delete and legal-hold workflows; irreversible deletion disabled until approved rules.
Acceptance condition: Retention job skips held records, logs preview and authorization.

Proposed requirement: Sensitive fields and document reads shall be purpose-bound, masked by default, separately authorized and audited.
Acceptance condition: Direct endpoint, search, report and export attack paths cannot bypass masking.

Proposed requirement: Documents shall have separate metadata, encrypted object storage, document types, evidence status, versioning, permitted relationship and access scope.
Acceptance condition: Access to farmer profile does not automatically grant document download.

Proposed requirement: Raw survey tracks shall have shorter configurable retention than final polygons and shall not become continuous officer tracking.
Acceptance condition: No GPS capture when survey off; audited scheduled removal under policy.

Proposed requirement: Client shall control its business data while developer retains separately agreed software IP; standard authorized data export shall remain available.
Acceptance condition: Signed termination procedure produces readable structured export without secret credentials.

Proposed requirement: Contract exit shall propose a 30-day orderly handover window, subject to signed terms and legal retention.
Acceptance condition: Data export, backups disposal/legal holds and deletion certificate steps documented.

Proposed requirement: Import shall accept controlled CSV/Excel templates with mapping, validation preview, row-level errors and duplicate review.
Acceptance condition: Bad rows cannot force all-or-nothing silent corruption; approved batch has source lineage.

Proposed requirement: Import approvals, idempotency, rollback/compensation and correction shall be audited with source file hash and row mapping.
Acceptance condition: Re-import same approved batch does not duplicate farmers or stock.

Proposed requirement: Each requirement and change shall have source, version, owner, approval status and conflict resolution record.
Acceptance condition: Conflicting sources produce flagged reconciliation item, not silent override.

Proposed requirement: Change requests shall record technical, security, schedule and cost impacts and require both authorized client/developer approvals before contractual scope alteration.
Acceptance condition: Unapproved request does not appear in approved baseline.

Proposed requirement: Final SRS, architecture, roadmap, quotation and Sinhala client explanation shall be prepared before sign-off; all 71 choices remain provisional until then.
Acceptance condition: Review package identifies approver/date/signature, bilingual what/why/how/duration/cost rationale and unresolved assumptions.

Proposed requirement: Initial production shall use portable Docker deployment on a cost-conscious VPS, with migration path to managed services.
Acceptance condition: Restore/redeploy rehearsal on a new VM recovers service without undocumented personal machine dependency.

Proposed requirement: Developer company shall own and operate hosting accounts/services and invoice client under agreed contract, distinct from data rights.
Acceptance condition: Contracts and runbook list operator custodians and client data controller contact.

Proposed requirement: Daily encrypted offsite backups plus feasible WAL archiving shall target proposed 1h RPO and 8h RTO only when restore tests substantiate.
Acceptance condition: Restore exercise records observed RPO/RTO rather than claimed targets.

Proposed requirement: Production secrets shall be in protected VPS environment files outside Git; cron-based rotation shall apply only to safely rotatable credentials with tested coordination.
Acceptance condition: Rotation leaves both old encrypted data and new sessions recoverable; secrets absent from logs/artifacts.

Proposed requirement: Monitoring shall cover VPS, API, database, backups, offline sync errors and escalation with sensitive-data sanitization.
Acceptance condition: Failed backup/API unreachable results in correctly routed actionable alert.

Proposed requirement: Structured UAT shall exercise approved requirements in real field conditions, classify severity and block critical security/integrity defects before written acceptance.
Acceptance condition: UAT pack maps acceptance case to FR/NFR and client tester sign-off.

Proposed requirement: English/Sinhala frontend and GIS interactions shall target WCAG 2.2 AA, with non-drag alternatives, keyboard use and field-device tests.
Acceptance condition: Manual and automated checks pass documented target or have signed exception.

Proposed requirement: Developer company shall deliver initial role-based training and basic manuals, with additional training separately scoped.
Acceptance condition: Admin and officer can perform supervised critical field workflows after training.

Proposed requirement: Rollout shall start with complete approved first-release modules in a bounded pilot, then expand only after acceptance gates and safe rollback plans.
Acceptance condition: Pilot pass/fail and rollback drill signed before next region.

Proposed requirement: Developer shall operate under recurring hosting/maintenance SLA with severity-based response targets and defined enhancements exclusions.
Acceptance condition: Support contract separates incident response from new feature requests.

Proposed requirement: Production CI/CD shall include staging, automated checks, explicit approval, safe versioned DB migrations, verified backups and offline-client compatibility.
Acceptance condition: Bad migration aborts with no orphaned writes; old pending mutation can still sync.

Proposed requirement: No work shall be described as fully approved or deployment-ready solely due to this provisional decision register.
Acceptance condition: Approval table remains pending until authorized written client sign-off.

Proposed requirement: All protected reads/writes, aggregates, maps and exports shall be denied by default at service and PostgreSQL policy/function layers.
Acceptance condition: Mutation-checked Officer A/B, cross-project/region, direct SQL/RLS negative suite.

Proposed requirement: Privileged MFA, step-up and session revocation shall be enforced against current database identity and approved-device state.
Acceptance condition: Authentication red-team cases for session fixation, CSRF, stale JWT/BFF, revoked device and MFA replay.

Proposed requirement: Sensitive data shall be encrypted at rest and in transit; field-local vault shall use authenticated encryption and partition binding.
Acceptance condition: Tamper, ciphertext swap, browser storage inspection, TLS downgrade and key-disclosure tests.

Proposed requirement: Root and encryption-key rotation shall be controlled, atomic, recoverable and non-destructive; automatic cron rotation shall be limited to rehearsed eligible keys.
Acceptance condition: Rehearsed rotation with old backups, active sessions and in-flight operations.

Proposed requirement: Recovery shall not create an admin decryption backdoor; escrow/recovery keys, approvals and grant metadata must be separately protected.
Acceptance condition: Independent crypto assessment, two-person approval where classified high-risk, wrong-approver denial.

Proposed requirement: Data processing shall have recorded lawful purpose and reviewed Sri Lankan legal basis, privacy notices, retention schedules and external provider assessments.
Acceptance condition: Legal sign-off plus data-flow inventory, breach test and retention audit.

Proposed requirement: Logs shall exclude secrets, access tokens, full NIC, raw GPS trace and other unnecessary personal data.
Acceptance condition: Automated log scanner and manual incident response review.

Proposed requirement: Physical device posture checks must not be claimed if the PWA cannot attest them; unsupported or unverified controls restrict offline authoring.
Acceptance condition: Acceptance checklist on actual models and adverse OS/browser settings.

Proposed requirement: Pilot offline authoring policy shall propose a 7-day maximum since trusted successful online authentication, in addition to local inactivity lock.
Acceptance condition: Offline-clock manipulation, restart, sleep, storage reset and reconnect scenarios; unresolved limits documented.

Proposed requirement: An interrupted/retried offline mutation shall retain stable identities and be idempotent; no confirmed success without authoritative receipt.
Acceptance condition: Lost ACK, double replay, two-tab, crash-between-steps and cross-partition tests.

Proposed requirement: Offline data shall survive ordinary restart/browser application updates where supported and remain recoverable after expiry without permitting new unauthorized edits.
Acceptance condition: Browser restart/upgrade and encrypted backup restore on approved same partition.

Proposed requirement: Survey capture shall visibly detect loss of position updates or low confidence, never invent a walked segment, and offer recovery.
Acceptance condition: Test screen-off, background tab, battery saver and GPS permission removal on devices.

Proposed requirement: Offline map package download shall be limited to authorized areas with rights-verified provider terms and bounded storage quota.
Acceptance condition: License checklist, package integrity test, user storage pressure and removal tests.

Proposed requirement: Proposed benchmark profile uses 3,000 farmer records and 20–40 concurrent staff solely for planning until real client load is confirmed.
Acceptance condition: Client approves load profile; then p95 endpoint/KPI response budgets measured and recorded.

Proposed requirement: Scoped spatial queries shall use appropriate indexes and bounded geometry/viewport limits with observed worst-case plan analysis.
Acceptance condition: Explain plans and p95 GIS query times on realistic projected land geometries.

Proposed requirement: Custom reports and scheduled jobs shall impose query cost/row/time caps and capacity safeguards.
Acceptance condition: Abuse test for expensive cross-geography filters while interactive API remains responsive.

Proposed requirement: Concurrent resource issues shall preserve stock invariants using database-level locking, constraints and idempotency.
Acceptance condition: Race test with parallel offline submissions cannot post negative/over-allocated authoritative stock.

Proposed requirement: Proposed production backup RPO 1 hour and RTO 8 hours are contractual candidates, not guaranteed without measured restores.
Acceptance condition: Offsite encrypted point-in-time restore drill with evidence of recovered transaction and elapsed time.

Proposed requirement: Monitoring shall detect failed backup, API outage, DB saturation and sync backlog with assigned contacts and tested alerts.
Acceptance condition: Synthetic alert drills with timestamps and acknowledgment.

Proposed requirement: First-release target is WCAG 2.2 Level AA for web views, forms and GIS with accessible alternatives to drag-only operations.
Acceptance condition: Automated checks plus manual keyboard, screen reader, focus and touch testing.

Proposed requirement: Field officer interfaces shall prioritize readable high-contrast copy, large targets and sunlight legibility on approved phones.
Acceptance condition: Field usability exercise with realistic outdoor conditions in both languages.

Proposed requirement: English/Sinhala language selection shall cover navigation, validation, status, accessibility names and report labels without translating entered names.
Acceptance condition: Language-toggle end-to-end screenshots and native-speaker signoff.

Proposed requirement: Every queued operation shall clearly distinguish local save, pending, syncing, confirmed, rejected, conflicted, unconfirmed and expired access.
Acceptance condition: Usability test confirms officer does not misinterpret saved-on-device as saved-on-server.

Proposed requirement: Documentation/training shall show role-specific offline/GIS workflows and security-limited actions with approved terminology.
Acceptance condition: Designated admin/officer completes exercises after initial developer training.

Proposed requirement: Deployments shall be reproducible under developer-operated accounts, with container isolation and no unmanaged personal VPS access.
Acceptance condition: Fresh-server documented rehearsal with least-privileged accounts.

Proposed requirement: Schema migration shall be versioned, repeat-safe where designed, and compatible with at least the approved maximum offline client window or managed update gate.
Acceptance condition: v3→v4 vault staged update and older-client pending mutation sync tests.

Proposed requirement: Backup data and essential decryption material shall survive production VPS destruction, with separated offsite custody.
Acceptance condition: Restore to isolated environment with new VM and verified key recovery.

Proposed requirement: Support coverage, exclusions, incident severity, response targets and client escalation shall be contractual rather than implied.
Acceptance condition: Signed SLA documents and incident exercise.

Proposed requirement: Requirements, ADRs, releases, risk exceptions and approvals shall retain version, author, decision date and evidence link.
Acceptance condition: Change-control audit shows no undocumented scope change.

Proposed requirement: New features shall not claim accessibility or security certification from CI-only pass; human acceptance evidence required.
Acceptance condition: Documented manual UAT and independent security review reports.
